audits.text:
## 8b595f6acd93

Source SHA256: `0b6c6131d05521b483cd9d69ab2c120019d6b65c152731f3ea42b74264c1bb85`.
Rule SHA256 and exact counterexample grids are in the evidence. All 768 sampled
inputs plus four canonical pairs (772 Racket comparisons) agree with the
independent reference: a zero center with four color-3 cardinal arms becomes 4.
All sampled self-checks accept.

**A1 — reproduced override-contract defect.**
`generate(0,0,difficulty='easy',grid_h=7)` raises
`draw_int('grid_h'): override 7 outside [8, 9]`, although AXES advertises 7..16.
The difficulty-specific sampling interval doubles as override validity. Keep
sampling preferences separate from declared valid overrides, or narrow AXES.
No claim about every other override was needed or made.

**A2 — measured weakness, NOT a universal shortcut.** A wrong rule that fills
when at least three cardinal arms are green exactly matches 221/256 easy,
174/256 medium, and 182/256 hard draws (577/768 total). It fails all four
canonical pairs, whose incomplete plus motifs supply the distinction.
The generator draws only complete pluses explicitly, but interactions among
multiple pluses DO create partial-pattern counterexamples: 191/768 sampled
inputs refute this rival. Therefore an earlier suspicion that it passes every
generated input was disproved; the new zero-coverage gate correctly does not
veto this target. Evidence includes the first generated counterexample.

Suggestion, not a patch: explicitly mix incomplete pluses beside complete ones,
rather than depend on accidental object interactions for this lesson. Test the
mixture before adopting it; the observed 191 counterexamples mean a blanket
"no negative support" claim would be false. Input diversity was 239/256 unique
easy, 256/256 medium, 256/256 hard; do not interpret these as learning rates.

triage.reason: Read both target reports; preserve distinctions between 191 sampled counterexamples and zero sampled support for canonical-refuted rivals. Audit targets unchanged, separate target reproductions pending.
